correctness.rationale: Every clique of K_m square K_n with >=2 vertices lies in a line. Maximal induced split sets admit a full row or column plus a maximal nonattacking rook placement on its complement. An unselected cell cannot extend such a set without violating clique/independent structure; the m=2 columns and 2x2 overlap are handled separately by induced C4 and 2K2. Enumerating oriented lines gives m(n)_{m-1} z^(m+n-1)+n(n-1)_m z^(2m) (m<n), 2m*m! z^(2m-1) for m=n>=3, and 4z^3 for m=n=2. Cancellation proves probability m/[m+d(d+1)]. Fresh direct split-partition checks on boards 2x2 through 3x4 matched.
